messages.content:
Fuel-efficiency report

Calculation: (45 litres ÷ 360 km) × 100 = 12.5 L/100 km.

Interpretation: The vehicle consumed an average of 12.5 litres for every 100 km travelled. Lower L/100 km means better fuel efficiency.

Independent check: 360 km is 3.6 × 100 km; 12.5 × 3.6 = 45 litres, matching the recorded consumption. The arithmetic checks out.
